remarks: Welcome to easy living at Sheffield Ridge! Move right into this spacious one-bedroom ranch style condominium in the heart of Norwalk. This turnkey unit has been well taken care of and is ready for its new owner. Enjoy convenient and comfortable living in this light and airy condo offering a large open concept living/dining room, galley kitchen, plenty of closet space and spacious bedroom. Common charges include an on-site Super, heat and hot water, trash, snow removal, and gated parking. But that's not all, this unit comes with a coveted interior, covered garage space (spot #15). The secure building has an elevator, coin operated laundry on the ground level along with a storage unit. This is a great opportunity to get into Norwalk and this location is fabulous, as it is close to vibrant downtown SONO, Wall Street and close to highways and many of Norwalk's finest restaurants! The complex is located across from the hospital and is close to plenty of shopping, parks and schools. Great for first time buyers, downsizers, or investors.
